meta.title: How your Frame-ID works — Velopass
meta.description: You scanned a Velopass Frame-ID. Here is the short version of how theft protection and bike registration work.
meta.ogDescription: Theft protection and bike registration — in one scan.

hero.title: How your Frame-ID works
hero.subtitle: Theft protection and registration of your bike — in one scan.

steps.title: How it works
steps.one: Stick the Frame-ID visibly on your frame.
steps.two: Scan the QR with your phone.
steps.three: Put the bike in your name in the digital passport.

value: A digital bike passport, theft protection, and a visible signal that your bike is registered.
